moment: Night watch on the bridge. Demir reviews two adjacent small screens, curious rather than panicked: one has three amber outlined alert markers, the other a calm thin green ring enclosing a flat horizontal waveform for ARIA. A separate threshold slider sits below the first screen. He holds a small run-log tablet in his left hand and touches the slider with one right fingertip. A restrained smile catches the absurdity of another disagreement filed among routine ship notices. No resolved classification, no alarms flooding the room, no text.
alt: Demir records the alert disagreement beside ARIA's calm waveform.
